subject.title: fix(memory-core): recover primary embedding provider after fallback latch (#96534)

question: Should maintainers require redacted live Gateway memory_search outage/fallback/primary-recovery proof before this provider-routing fix can merge, or explicitly override the proof gate for the deterministic MemoryIndexManager regression?
rationale: The code path looks coherent, but repository policy treats external PR real behavior proof as a merge gate and the contributor has stated that only mocked manager-level proof is available.

options.title: Require live recovery proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing Gateway memory_search entering fallback during a primary outage and later returning results after primary recovery.

options.title: Override mocked proof
options.body: A maintainer may accept the deterministic manager regression as sufficient for this internal recovery path, but that should be an explicit proof override.

options.title: Pause for a harness
options.body: Keep the PR open until someone adds or runs a reusable live Gateway/provider outage harness for this memory-core path.

recommendation.title: Require live recovery proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, or a recording showing Gateway memory_search entering fallback during a primary outage and later returning results after primary recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest local history in the memory provider-state helper boundary being extended and is a good owner for proof-sufficiency judgment.
